title: Morning, the chimney smoking
logline: The chimney across the bay smoking on one of the mornings — a thing it hasn't done since 1994 in the strip — and the page not remarking. The flats gold. The pup at the tide line. Reserved: what's burning.

panels.composition: The flats at low tide in morning sun with the cannery chimney across the bay sending up a thin line of smoke, an old three-legged dog at the tide line, gold mud and blue channels.
